papers.title_zh: 潜在多智能体系统的选择性和混合状态通信
papers.summary_zh: 高效通信仍然是大型语言模型多智能体系统的主要瓶颈。潜在通信通过在代理之间传输内部模型状态来减少重复的自然语言交换，但这些传输仍然成本高昂，并且通常是围绕传统的 KV 缓存表示设计的。我们从两个互补的角度来解决这个问题。我们引入了 SelectKV，一种边界感知方法，可以选择性地通信 KV 状态，同时保护继承的上下文；以及 HyLaMAS，它通过共享工作区通信 KV 缓存和循环状态，将潜在协作扩展到混合线性注意力模型。在六个基准测试中，SelectKV 将通信的 KV 位置和逻辑 KV 有效负载减少了 9.7-9.9%，两个基准测试的准确度没有变化，比三个基准测试低 1 个百分点，在 HumanEval+ 上降低了 6 个百分点。在 Qwen3.5 模型规模上，HyLaMAS 将解码输出标记减少了 53-80%，并相对于基于文本的多代理通信实现了 1.16-2.78 倍的加速。总之，这些独立评估的方法代表了跨传统 Transformer 和混合模型架构进行高效潜在状态通信的两种互补方法。

papers.title: Multi-Draft On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Drafters
papers.summary: Speculative decoding is used to reduce the inference cost of language models. One-step diffusion drafters propose a block of multiple tokens in parallel, reducing the sequential cost of speculative decoding. On-policy distillation trains these drafters using verifier feedback on their own proposals. However, parallel drafting makes this feedback difficult to use: the drafter predicts each token without observing the preceding tokens sampled within the same block, while the verifier conditions its prediction on those tokens. Different sampled prefixes therefore give different verifier targets for the same drafter prediction. We show that distilling against these targets separately can suppress tokens that are plausible after some prefixes but unlikely after others, harming draft acceptance. We explain the effects of this mismatch and introduce Multi-Draft On-Policy Distillation (MDraft), a new parallel drafter distillation method which samples several draft blocks from the same context and aggregates the verifier's full-vocabulary conditionals across their prefixes. We use all the drafts to collect information from the verifier, allowing support from alternative prefixes to influence the training target. The resulting algorithm improves the acceptance length of a parallel drafter beyond the level of pre-training, and alleviates the effects of the distributional mismatch. MDraft changes only training, retaining the drafter's architecture and inference procedure, allowing the resulting drafter to be used as-is in place of the pretrained checkpoint. Experiments on a suite of mathematical, coding, and conversational tasks show longer accepted drafts than prior distillation methods.

papers.title_zh: 适用于扩散牵伸机的多牵伸按策略蒸馏
papers.summary_zh: 推测解码用于降低语言模型的推理成本。一步扩散起草者提出并行多个令牌的块，减少推测解码的顺序成本。政策蒸馏利用验证者对自己提案的反馈来培训这些起草者。然而，并行起草使得这种反馈难以使用：起草者在不观察同一块内采样的先前令牌的情况下预测每个令牌，而验证者则根据这些令牌进行预测。因此，不同的采样前缀为相同的起草者预测提供了不同的验证者目标。我们表明，分别针对这些目标进行提炼可以抑制在某些前缀后看似合理但在其他前缀后不太可能的标记，从而损害草案的接受。我们解释了这种不匹配的影响，并引入了多草案按策略蒸馏（MDraft），这是一种新的并行起草者蒸馏方法，它从同一上下文中采样多个草稿块，并在其前缀上聚合验证者的完整词汇条件。我们使用所有草稿从验证者那里收集信息，允许替代前缀的支持来影响训练目标。由此产生的算法将并行起草器的接受长度提高到超出预训练的水平，并减轻了分布不匹配的影响。 MDraft 仅更改训练，保留绘图器的架构和推理程序，允许按原样使用生成的绘图器来代替预训练的检查点。对一系列数学、编码和对话任务的实验表明，比以前的蒸馏方法接受的草稿更长。

papers.title: Demystifying the Impact of Physical Non-Idealities on Kernel Performance
papers.summary: Physical non-idealities in integrated circuit (IC) design, fabrication, and operation are concealed by conventional hardware abstractions, causing unexpected performance variations in kernels. For large-scale workloads, such as AI training and inference, performance unpredictability can lead to substantial losses. We investigate this problem in NVIDIA H100 GPUs with their distributed shared memory (DSMEM) architectural feature that reduces data movement from the L2 cache to Streaming Multiprocessors (SMs) with multicast loads, and uncover that floorsweeping restricts the number of SMs usable for clustered execution, increasing the number of execution waves of kernels. To alleviate this performance penalty, we introduce the wave-aware clustering strategy that accounts for these resource constraints and improves the throughput of the Hopper version of FlashAttention 4 by up to 5.30% over the unclustered baseline. Furthermore, we discover that the power constraint imposed by the thermal design power (TDP) limit causes the DSMEM-based memory bandwidth optimization to improve the throughput even for compute-bound kernels by creating a power headroom for higher SM frequencies through reduced data movement. Extending this analysis beyond GPUs, we find that power constraints also limit throughput scaling on Tenstorrent's Wormhole accelerator, highlighting the broader importance of accounting for physical non-idealities in kernel performance engineering.

papers.title_zh: 非理想物理条件下的内核性能工程
papers.summary_zh: 集成电路 (IC) 设计和制造中的物理非理想性被传统的硬件抽象所掩盖，但它们可能会限制内核性能并掩盖优化机会。我们以 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上的分布式共享内存 (DSMEM) 为案例研究，展示了地板扫描如何限制可用于集群执行的硬件资源，从而可能抵消 DSMEM 减少数据移动带来的好处。在这些见解的指导下，我们开发了一种波感知集群策略，该策略考虑了这些资源限制，以提高内核性能。使用全局加载和广播微基准、GEMM 和 FlashAttention 4 Hopper 版本的评估展示了这些限制的性能影响，波感知集群将 FlashAttention 4 吞吐量比其基准提高了 5.30%。我们进一步表明，在热设计功耗 (TDP) 限制下，减少数据移动可以通过动态电压和频率调节 (DVFS) 实现更高的流式多处理器 (SM) 频率，从而解释了意想不到的吞吐量改进。将这一分析扩展到 GPU 之外，我们发现功耗限制也限制了 Tenstorrent 虫洞加速器的吞吐量扩展，这凸显了在分析和优化内核性能时考虑物理非理想性的更广泛重要性。

papers.title: Bayesian Inference of Expensive Simulators: Survey and Comparison of Design Choices
papers.summary: We present a survey of approaches to Bayesian inference with simulator forward models, focusing on settings with prohibitively expensive simulators. In this domain, Bayesian optimization-based methods have emerged as the most promising approach. We unify existing methods into a general framework, enabling consistent reasoning about shared algorithmic structure across the fragmented literature. Within this framework, we identify the primary design choices and perform a systematic empirical comparison of their effects on inference efficiency in terms of required simulation budget. A key result of our study is that inference efficiency is often dominated by the choice of surrogate-model response variable, as it directly governs the complexity of the modeled function. Specifically, we demonstrate that the prevalent scalar log-likelihood is a poor response variable, as it discards crucial information. Based on this insight, we introduce the concept of custom \emph{proxy variables}: transformations of simulator outputs engineered to retain more information and provide smoother response surfaces, substantially improving inference efficiency over standard response variables. We provide actionable guidance and a numerically robust Julia package to facilitate practical adoption of Bayesian optimization for simulator inverse problems.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 8 figures. Accepted for publication in Statistics and Computing. This is the submitted manuscript; the revised version, including changes based on peer review, is available from the authors upon request

papers.title_zh: 昂贵模拟器的贝叶斯推理：设计选择的调查和比较
papers.summary_zh: 我们对模拟器前向模型的贝叶斯推理方法进行了调查，重点关注极其昂贵的模拟器的设置。在这个领域，基于贝叶斯优化的方法已成为最有前途的方法。我们将现有方法统一到一个通用框架中，从而能够对分散的文献中的共享算法结构进行一致的推理。在此框架内，我们确定了主要的设计选择，并根据所需的模拟预算对它们对推理效率的影响进行了系统的实证比较。我们研究的一个关键结果是，推理效率通常由代理模型响应变量的选择决定，因为它直接控制建模函数的复杂性。具体来说，我们证明普遍的标量对数似然是一个较差的响应变量，因为它丢弃了关键信息。基于这一见解，我们引入了自定义 \emph{代理变量} 的概念：模拟器输出的转换旨在保留更多信息并提供更平滑的响应面，从而显着提高标准响应变量的推理效率。我们提供可操作的指导和数值稳健的 Julia 包，以促进模拟器逆问题的贝叶斯优化的实际采用。

papers.title: DCKV: Learned Transform Coding of the Prompt KV Cache in Hybrid Language Models
papers.summary: Hybrid language models keep a key-value (KV) cache only in their few full-attention layers, but this cache is still the part of a prompt's state that grows with the prompt and that must be stored or moved to reuse it. We present DCKV, a differentiable codec for the KV cache and the first KV-cache codec that is trained end to end. Its transform, its quantizer and its entropy models, which are conditioned on the prompt tokens and on already decoded neighbouring positions, are optimized together against the frozen language model, both for the code length that the entropy models assign and for the change of the model's output. On Qwen3.5-2B, DCKV stores a compressed token in more than 55 times fewer bytes than bf16 at a loss of at most 1.8 points on three long-context benchmarks, and in more than 100 times fewer bytes at a loss of at most 3.6 points.

papers.title_zh: DCKV：混合语言模型中提示 KV 缓存的学习转换编码
papers.summary_zh: 混合语言模型仅在少数全注意力层中保留键值 (KV) 缓存，但此缓存仍然是提示状态的一部分，随着提示的增长而增长，并且必须存储或移动才能重用它。我们提出了 DCKV，一种用于 KV 缓存的可微分编解码器，也是第一个经过端到端训练的 KV 缓存编解码器。它的变换、量化器和熵模型以提示标记和已解码的相邻位置为条件，针对熵模型分配的代码长度和模型输出的变化，针对冻结语言模型一起进行优化。在 Qwen3.5-2B 上，DCKV 存储压缩令牌的字节数比 bf16 少 55 倍以上，在三个长上下文基准测试中最多损失 1.8 分，而在三个长上下文基准测试中，DCKV 存储压缩令牌的字节数减少 100 倍以上，最多损失 3.6 分。

papers.title: God Does Not Play Dice: Enforcing Batch Invariance in Agentic Kernel Generation
papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) serving systems dynamically batch user requests for GPU execution, so the same request may be processed alongside different requests across runs. If the GPU kernels lack batch invariance (BI), this changing batch context can alter the numerical output for an unchanged input, undermining reproducibility. Existing kernel generation agents focus on correctness and efficiency but \emph{overlook BI}. We find 19 confirmed BI violations among 83 batch-applicable released artifacts. To address this limitation, we propose \tool, which combines contract-guided static dependency analysis with dynamic validation of bitwise consistency across batch contexts. \tool is designed as a plug-in component for general kernel agents, allowing their original optimization capabilities to be reused while adding BI enforcement. We integrate it as successive acceptance gates in the optimization loop, rejecting structurally risky or dynamically non-invariant candidates before performance benchmarking and returning feedback to the agent. Experiments across three agent frameworks under baseline and BI-aware generation on real world LLM serving tasks show that \tool improves the BI pass rate from 67.6\% to 91.9\% while retaining 91.8\% of the baseline geometric mean speedup. These results demonstrate that \tool can be incorporated into kernel optimization by agents as an additional reliability objective alongside correctness and speed.

papers.title_zh: 上帝不掷骰子：在代理内核生成中强制执行批次不变性
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 服务系统动态批处理用于 GPU 执行的用户请求，因此同一请求可以在运行期间与不同请求一起处理。如果 GPU 内核缺乏批量不变性 (BI)，则这种不断变化的批量上下文可能会改变未更改输入的数值输出，从而破坏再现性。现有的内核生成代理注重正确性和效率，但\emph{忽略了 BI}。我们在 83 个批量适用的已发布工件中发现了 19 个已确认的 BI 违规行为。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了 \tool ，它将契约引导的静态依赖分析与跨批处理上下文的按位一致性的动态验证结合起来。 \tool 被设计为通用内核代理的插件组件，允许在添加 BI 强制的同时重用其原始优化功能。我们将其作为优化循环中的连续接受门进行集成，在性能基准测试并将反馈返回给代理之前拒绝结构上有风险或动态非不变的候选者。在现实世界 LLM 服务任务上的基线和 BI 感知生成下的三个代理框架的实验表明，该工具将 BI 通过率从 67.6% 提高到 91.9%，同时保留了 91.8% 的基线几何平均加速。这些结果表明，\tool 可以被代理纳入内核优化中，作为除了正确性和速度之外的附加可靠性目标。

papers.title: Folding Attention Biases into Keys Makes Compacted KV Caches Run on Standard Kernels
papers.summary: Attention Matching (AM) compacts a KV cache by keeping some keys per head, refitting their values and adding a bias to each kept key's logit. FlashAttention and vLLM's paged caches have no input for it. We fold the bias into the keys along one closed-form direction per head, fitted on context queries, giving a plain cache with AM's size and head dimension and the model's own query path; the output error is bounded by how far each query's projection on that direction is from 1. With equal per-head budgets, unmodified vLLM serves folded caches through a KV connector, matching Hugging Face's answers on all 51 Qwen3-4B questions and its greedy output on 180 of 200 Qwen3-14B LongBench samples. With equal budgets on QuALITY (Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, 8B, Llama-3.1-8B) and LongHealth (three Qwen3 models), the fold is within noise of AM's accuracy in 13 of 14 settings, with lower KL to the full cache than dropping the bias in all 12 where both ran. Under the published per-head budgets, on Qwen3-4B, its Instruct-2507 variant and Llama-3.1-8B, it is within noise of AM in 9 of 10, no longer beats dropping the bias in KL, and the two each win once in accuracy.

papers.title_zh: 将注意力偏差折叠到键中使紧凑的 KV 缓存在标准内核上运行
papers.summary_zh: 注意力匹配 (AM) 通过在每个头保留一些键、重新调整它们的值并向每个保留键的 logit 添加偏差来压缩 KV 缓存。 FlashAttention 和 vLLM 的分页缓存没有输入。我们沿着每个头的一个封闭形式方向将偏差折叠到键中，适合上下文查询，给出一个具有 AM 大小和头尺寸以及模型自己的查询路径的普通缓存；输出误差受限于每个查询在该方向上的投影距 1 的距离。在每个头预算相等的情况下，未修改的 vLLM 通过 KV 连接器提供折叠缓存，匹配 Hugging Face 在所有 51 个 Qwen3-4B 问题上的答案及其在 200 个 Qwen3-14B LongBench 样本中的 180 个上的贪婪输出。在 QuALITY（Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B、Llama-3.1-8B）和 LongHealth（三个 Qwen3 模型）上的预算相同的情况下，在 14 个设置中的 13 个设置中，折叠在 AM 精度的噪音范围内，与在所有 12 个设置中都运行的所有 12 个设置中降低偏差相比，全缓存的 KL 更低。根据公布的人均预算，在 Qwen3-4B、其 Instruct-2507 变体和 Llama-3.1-8B 上，10 次中有 9 次都在 AM 的噪音范围内，不再击败在 KL 中放弃偏差，并且两者在准确度上各赢一次。

papers.title: WAKMan: Workload Aware KVCache Manager
papers.summary: Prefix caching enables a Large Language Model (LLM) servers to reuse the Key-Value (KV) states and accelerate prefill computation stage for requests that share a prefix with earlier prompts, thus reducing latency and serving cost. With limited memory resource, the KV cache eviction policy becomes a decisive factor in determining the overall benefits of prefix caching. Production traffic may have single-turn, multi-turn, agentic, or a mixture of any combination of these request types. Our findings indicate that agentic steps return within seconds and favor recency, while popular prompts and long conversations return after many other requests and favor frequency. Across 20 mixes, no single policy is always best: vLLM's default strategy LRU provides 12% higher cache hits as compared to the frequency-oriented S3FIFO on agentic-heavy mixes but trails it by up to 22% elsewhere, and even a single workload parameter can flip the winner even for any particular mix. We present WAKMan, a workload-aware KV cache manager that picks its eviction policy from live traffic without knowing request types or reading prompts. It improves hit rate over LRU by 5 percentage points on average, with the lowest mean and worst-case optimality gap of all policies.
papers.comment: Work done during internship at Capital One

papers.title_zh: WAKMan：工作负载感知 KVCache 管理器
papers.summary_zh: 前缀缓存使大型语言模型 (LLM) 服务器能够重用键值 (KV) 状态，并加速与早期提示共享前缀的请求的预填充计算阶段，从而减少延迟和服务成本。在内存资源有限的情况下，KV缓存驱逐策略成为决定前缀缓存整体效益的决定性因素。生产流量可以具有单轮、多轮、代理或这些请求类型的任意组合的混合。我们的研究结果表明，代理步骤会在几秒钟内返回，并且有利于新近度，而流行的提示和长时间对话会在许多其他请求和偏好频率之后返回。在 20 种混合中，没有单一策略总是最好的：与代理重的混合上面向频率的 S3FIFO 相比，vLLM 的默认策略 LRU 提供的缓存命中率高出 12%，但在其他地方落后了 22%，甚至对于任何特定的混合，即使是单个工作负载参数也可以翻转获胜者。我们推出了 WAKMan，这是一种工作负载感知的 KV 缓存管理器，它可以在不知道请求类型或阅读提示的情况下从实时流量中选择驱逐策略。与 LRU 相比，它的命中率平均提高了 5 个百分点，并且在所有策略中均值和最坏情况最优性差距最小。

papers.title: CrowdCC: Jointly Benchmarking Corruption Robustness and Deployment Quantization in Crowd Counting
papers.summary: Crowd-counting models deployed on edge devices face two challenges: inputs are degraded along the capture and transmission pipeline, while models are often quantized to satisfy resource constraints of the edge. Yet corruption robustness and deployment quantization are typically evaluated separately. We introduce CrowdCC, a controlled benchmark that jointly evaluates these effects across 23 deployment-motivated corruptions at three severity levels, four crowd-counting datasets, and 26 models. We evaluate TensorRT engines at FP32, FP16, and post-training INT8 precision on an A100 GPU, alongside throughput and energy measurements on corresponding Jetson Orin~NX configurations. The corruptions span six families, with head annotations adjusted when geometry or visibility changes. Our results show that capture-chain corruptions consistently cause the largest degradation across evaluated models, while crowd density affects absolute and relative errors differently. Accuracy on clean images does not reliably predict performance on the corresponding corrupted images. INT8 changes corruption robustness more than FP16, without a consistent direction, and does not consistently improve latency or energy efficiency. INT8 inference efficiency is strongly associated with reformat overhead in the compiled engine, with slowdowns also observed under limited INT8 coverage. Precision changes corrupted-error rankings and robustness--cost frontiers, highlighting the need to consider corruption robustness and deployment cost jointly when selecting models and precision. The code is available at https://github.com/Tulane-Computer-Architecture-Systems/CrowdCC-Release.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要、设计扎实，但机制解释仍不足
pros: 首次系统联合评测腐化鲁棒性与量化部署成本，贴近真实边缘落地场景
覆盖面广且控制变量较好：23类腐化、4数据集、26模型及A100/Orin实测能效

papers.title_zh: CrowdCC：对人群计数中的腐败鲁棒性和部署量化进行联合基准测试
papers.summary_zh: 部署在边缘设备上的人群计数模型面临两个转变：输入沿着捕获和传输管道降级，同时模型被量化以满足资源限制。然而，腐败鲁棒性和部署量化通常是分开评估的。我们引入了 CrowdCC，这是一种受控损坏基准，它使用 3 个严重级别的 23 个部署驱动的损坏、4 个人群计数数据集和 26 个使用 A100 TensorRT 引擎（FP32、FP16 和训练后 INT8 精度）的模型，以及相应 Jetson Orin NX 配置的吞吐量和能量测量来联合评估这些影响。损坏跨越六个系列，当几何形状或可见性发生变化时，头部注释会进行调整。我们的评估表明，捕获链损坏始终会在评估的模型中产生最大的退化，而人群密度对绝对误差和相对误差的影响不同。干净的准确性并不能完全预测损坏的性能。 INT8 比 FP16 对损坏鲁棒性的改变要大得多，没有系统性方向，并且不能持续改善延迟或能量。 INT8 推理效率与编译引擎中的重新格式化开销密切相关，而在有限的 INT8 覆盖范围下也观察到速度下降。精度改变了损坏错误排名和鲁棒性成本边界，说明了为什么模型选择必须同时考虑损坏鲁棒性和测量的部署成本。该代码可从 https://github.com/Tulane-Computer-Architecture-Systems/CrowdCC-Release 获取。

papers.title: INC-MoE: Overlapping In-Network Collectives and Expert Computation for Expert-Parallel Mixture-of-Experts Inference
papers.summary: In expert-parallel mixture-of-experts (MoE) serving, dispatch moves tokens to the accelerators hosting their selected experts, and combine returns expert outputs to each token's owner. Both operations lie on the critical path and can dominate MoE layer latency in multi-node deployments. We present INC-MoE, an expert-parallel MoE layer that offloads dispatch and combine to the network switch and overlaps both collectives with each other and with expert computation. Dispatch uses in-network AllGather through switch-side multicast, while combine uses in-network ReduceScatter through switch-side reduction. Both collectives use message semantics between the end hosts and the switch. Because the in-network collectives load opposite directions of each link, executing them concurrently reduces bandwidth-bound communication time by $(N-2)/(2(N-1))$ relative to concurrent ring-based collectives: 33% for four ranks and 43% for eight. INC-MoE partitions tokens into bands and processes them through a three-stage AllGather-feed-forward network (FFN)-ReduceScatter pipeline inside a single persistent kernel. At steady state, role-specialized thread blocks gather the next band, compute the current band, and reduce the previous band concurrently, overlapping both collectives with each other and with computation using device-side synchronization. INC-MoE integrates as a drop-in replacement for the MoE layer of vLLM. We evaluate it in an emulated four-node scale-out deployment with a dedicated accelerator emulating an in-network computing (INC) switch. On OLMoE prefill with four-way expert parallelism, INC-MoE reduces time to first token (TTFT) by up to 33% and increases throughput by up to 50% relative to vLLM's default collective path, while matching its outputs.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但实证外推性仍待加强。
pros: 将调度与回收卸载到交换机并与专家计算三向重叠，系统设计完整且有针对性

papers.title_zh: INC-MoE：用于专家并行混合专家推理的重叠网络内集体和专家计算
papers.summary_zh: 在专家并行专家混合 (MoE) 服务中，调度将代币移动到托管其选定专家的加速器，并将专家输出组合返回给每个代币的所有者。这两种操作都位于关键路径上，并且可以主导多节点部署中的 MoE 层延迟。我们提出了 INC-MoE，这是一个专家并行的 MoE 层，它可以卸载调度并合并到网络交换机，并将两个集合相互重叠并与专家计算重叠。 Dispatch通过交换机端组播使用网内AllGather，而combine通过交换机端归约使用网内ReduceScatter。这两个集合都在终端主机和交换机之间使用消息语义。由于网络内集合加载每个链路的相反方向，因此相对于并发基于环的集合，同时执行它们可将带宽限制的通信时间减少 $(N-2)/(2(N-1))$：四列为 33%，八列为 43%。 INC-MoE 将令牌划分为带，并通过单个持久内核内的三级 AllGather-前馈网络 (FFN)-ReduceScatter 管道对其进行处理。在稳定状态下，角色专用线程块收集下一个带，计算当前带，并同时减少前一个带，使两个集合相互重叠并使用设备端同步进行计算。 INC-MoE 集成为 vLLM MoE 层的直接替代品。我们在模拟的四节点横向扩展部署中对其进行评估，并使用模拟网络内计算 (INC) 交换机的专用加速器。在具有四路专家并行性的 OLMoE 预填充上，相对于 vLLM 的默认集体路径，INC-MoE 将首次令牌时间 (TTFT) 缩短高达 33%，并将吞吐量提高高达 50%，同时匹配其输出。

papers.title: Stratum: Repository Memory for Coding Agents Beyond the Context Window
papers.summary: Context windows have grown a thousand-fold, yet coding agents still start every session with no memory of their past work. They re-read files, retry failed approaches, and forget root causes they established hours earlier. This is not a context-length problem but a memory-architecture problem. Our hypothesis: coding agents need persistent, experience-aware repository memory, so that knowledge survives from one session to the next. Three measurements on real repositories motivate the design. First, mid-size projects already exceed the largest production context windows, and storing knowledge inside the model's key-value (KV) cache costs $10^4$ to $10^5$ times more bytes than storing it as indexed text. Second, across 752 real bug-fix commits, the median fix edits two files, and these files plus their direct imports amount to less than 10% of the repository; the bottleneck is selection, not capacity. Third, even with transitive import reachability and test links, 47% of co-edited file pairs remain structurally disconnected; the knowledge needed for selection must be mined from history and experience. We sketch Stratum, a tiered memory that lives with the repository and serves it through page-safe tools: every response states what was returned, what remains, and what it cost. Retrieval over a store of one million nodes takes 1.7 ms at the median. In a multi-session experiment on eight real bugs, a fresh agent that inherited a prior session's memory, written by a different model, identified the root-cause file in 21 of 24 trials versus 6 of 24 for a retrieval-only baseline (Fisher $p<10^{-4}$), at 4.5x lower median token cost. With the notes of all eight investigations pooled in one store, success remained 8/8.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Replication package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23615180

papers.title_zh: Stratum：上下文窗口之外的编码代理的存储库内存
papers.summary_zh: 上下文窗口已经增长了一千倍，但编码代理仍然在开始每个会话时不记得他们过去的工作。他们重新读取文件，重试失败的方法，并忘记了几个小时前确定的根本原因。这不是上下文长度问题，而是内存架构问题。我们的假设：编码代理需要持久的、经验感知的存储库内存，以便知识能够从一个会话保存到下一个会话。对真实存储库的三个测量激发了设计。首先，中型项目已经超过了最大的生产上下文窗口，并且将知识存储在模型的键值 (KV) 缓存内的成本比存储为索引文本的字节数多 10^4$ 到 $10^5$ 倍。其次，在 752 个真实的错误修复提交中，修复的中位数是编辑两个文件，这些文件加上它们的直接导入总计不到存储库的 10%；瓶颈在于选择，而不是能力。第三，即使具有传递导入可达性和测试链接，47% 的共同编辑文件对在结构上仍然是断开的；选择所需的知识必须从历史和经验中挖掘。我们绘制了 Stratum 的草图，这是一种与存储库一起存在的分层内存，并通过页面安全工具为其提供服务：每个响应都会说明返回的内容、剩余的内容以及成本。检索一百万个节点的存储平均需要 1.7 毫秒。在针对 8 个真实错误的多会话实验中，继承了由不同模型编写的先前会话内存的新代理在 24 次试验中的 21 次中识别出了根本原因文件，而仅检索基线 (Fisher $p<10^{-4}$) 的 24 次试验中只有 6 次确定了根本原因文件，中位令牌成本降低了 4.5 倍。将所有八项调查的记录汇总到一家商店后，成功率仍为 8/8。

papers.title: Auto-Research Arena: Benchmarking and Advancing Auto-Research in Language Modeling
papers.summary: As autonomous research systems become more capable, benchmarks must both evaluate their performance and support meaningful research progress. We introduce Auto-Research Arena, a multi-target benchmark for evaluating autonomous research systems and discovering ideas in language modeling. Arena supports diverse research objectives within a shared experimental environment by separating admissibility from improvement: model quality and resource constraints determine whether a result qualifies, while the selected target measures progress among admissible results. We instantiate Arena in language model pretraining with nine targets spanning model, data, training, and inference efficiency, and evaluate seven research harnesses using two foundation models. Arena clearly differentiates existing harnesses across research objectives, with several sophisticated methods outperformed by our simple sequential search baseline, indicating substantial headroom in current auto-research systems. Beyond evaluation, Arena reveals a substantially broader frontier of model and system ideas aligned with active research directions. Reusing these discoveries in a new quality-driven search yields lower training loss under matched data and FLOPs and lower held-out BPB at the same model size. Together, Arena provides a common framework for benchmarking autonomous research and expanding its scope in language modeling. The code is available at https://github.com/Auto-Research-Arena/auto-research-arena

quality.label: 较高

papers.title_zh: 自动研究领域：语言建模领域的基准测试和推进自动研究
papers.summary_zh: 随着自主研究系统的能力变得越来越强大，基准必须评估其性能并支持有意义的研究进展。我们推出了 Auto-Research Arena，这是一个用于评估自主研究系统和发现语言建模思想的多目标基准。 Arena 通过将可接受性与改进分开来支持共享实验环境中的不同研究目标：模型质量和资源限制决定结果是否合格，而选定的目标则衡量可接受结果中的进展。我们在语言模型预训练中实例化了 Arena，具有涵盖模型、数据、训练和推理效率的九个目标，并使用两个基础模型评估了七个研究工具。 Arena 清楚地区分了跨研究目标的现有工具，其中几种复杂的方法优于我们简单的顺序搜索基线，这表明当前自动研究系统具有巨大的空间。除了评估之外，Arena 还揭示了与活跃研究方向相一致的更广泛的模型和系统思想前沿。在新的质量驱动搜索中重用这些发现可以降低匹配数据和 FLOP 下的训练损失，并在相同模型大小下降低保留的 BPB。 Arena 共同提供了一个通用框架，用于对自主研究进行基准测试并扩展其在语言建模方面的范围。代码可在 https://github.com/Auto-Research-Arena/auto-research-arena 获取

papers.title: TriTile: Three-Tier Attention for Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.summary: Attention over tens of thousands of visual tokens dominates the inference of video diffusion transformers (DiTs). Existing methods reduce this cost through sparsity, low precision, or both, but use a single precision for all kept tiles. We observe that the output error introduced by approximation varies widely across tiles. Many tiles can be skipped with little error, others must be computed but gain little beyond low precision, and a few retain substantial error even at low precision. We present TriTile, a training-free attention method that assigns each tile one of three approximation tiers: skipping it by replacing it with its block means, skimming it in NVFP4, or refining it with NVFP4 residual correction. A lightweight router predicts each tile's error under each tier from block statistics and spends extra compute on a tile only where it removes enough error; a single knob, a price on compute, controls the whole speed-quality trade-off. A fused kernel executes all three tiers in a single pass on the FP4 tensor cores. Over dense FlashAttention, TriTile speeds up generation by 1.38-1.83x on Wan2.2 at 23.0-27.6 dB PSNR, 2.28-2.32x on HunyuanVideo at 34.5-36.0 dB, and 1.84x on LTX-2.5 at 34.1 dB, and in every setting it Pareto-dominates every baseline in speed and PSNR.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且效果亮眼，但证据完整性待验证。
pros: 提出按tile误差分级的三档近似框架，较单一精度策略更细粒度
训练无关并宣称单核融合落地，端到端加速与画质指标兼顾

papers.title_zh: 分类：在视频扩散变压器中跳过、略读或细化注意力图块
papers.summary_zh: 对数以万计的视觉标记的关注主导了视频扩散变压器（DiT）的推理。现有方法通过稀疏性、低精度或两者兼而有之来降低此成本，但对所有保留的图块使用单一精度。我们观察到，近似引入的输出误差在各个图块之间变化很大。许多图块可以被跳过而几乎没有误差，其他图块必须进行计算，但除了低精度之外几乎没有什么增益，并且一些图块即使在低精度下仍保留很大的误差。我们提出了 Triage，一种免训练的注意力方法，为每个图块分配三个近似层之一：通过用其块均值替换它来跳过它，在 NVFP4 中略读它，或使用 NVFP4 残差校正对其进行细化。轻量级路由器根据块统计数据预测每个层下每个图块的错误，并仅当预测的误差减少证明额外计算合理时才将图块移动到更准确的层，并通过单一价格设置此权衡。融合内核在 RTX Blackwell GPU 的 FP4 张量核心上一次性执行所有三层。在 Wan2.2、HunyuanVideo 和 LTX-2.5 中，Triage 的端到端生成速度比密集 FlashAttention 提高了 2.32 倍，并且在五种设置中，它的运行速度比每个基线都快，同时 PSNR 比最高 PSNR 基线高 0.3-3.0 dB。

papers.title: InterQ-RL: Interaction-Aware Correction of Execution Mismatch in Quantized Agentic RL
papers.summary: Multi-turn agent reinforcement learning (RL) relies on long closed-loop rollouts, making generation and KV-cache costs a major bottleneck. Quantized rollout reduces these costs, but its low-precision executor also serves as the behavior policy and can induce execution mismatch with the learner. Existing quantized-RL methods are designed primarily for single-turn generation. They align the learner forward with quantized rollout or correct the current-token rollout-learner ratio, without modeling the policy history that produces each agent state. Even after quantization alignment, residual rollout-learner mismatch accumulates along the state-reaching policy history, so a current action may look locally aligned despite a mismatched history. We introduce InterQ-RL (Interaction-aware Quantized Reinforcement Learning) to correct this post-alignment mismatch. It applies bounded execution-prefix correction over the state-reaching policy history, allocates correction strength across action segments by effective support under a fixed displacement budget, and requires no additional model forward pass. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) backbones from 4B to 30B on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, with all quantized arms sharing the same rollout with 8-bit weights, activations, and KV cache (W8A8-KV8). Across four environment-backbone settings, InterQ-RL achieves the strongest quantized endpoint result, matching BF16 to within 0.7 points and exceeding it in two settings. It matches or exceeds the learning speed of alignment alone while avoiding its late performance regression.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法有新意但证据仍需加强。
pros: 聚焦量化执行与学习器失配这一长期被低估的多轮RL瓶颈，问题定义有价值。
提出基于状态到达历史的交互感知校正，并强调无需额外前向，兼顾效果与效率。
cons: 仅凭摘要看，理论保证、统计显著性与消融充分性仍不明确，跨任务泛化与稳定性证据可能不足。

papers.title_zh: InterQ-RL：量化代理强化学习中执行不匹配的交互感知修正
papers.summary_zh: 多轮代理强化学习 (RL) 依赖于长时间的闭环部署，使得生成和 KV 缓存成本成为主要瓶颈。量化推出降低了这些成本，但其低精度执行器也充当行为策略，并可能导致与学习器的执行不匹配。现有的量化强化学习方法主要是为单圈生成而设计的。它们使学习者与量化的推出保持一致，或者纠正当前代币推出与学习者的比率，而不对产生每个代理状态的策略历史进行建模。即使在量化对齐之后，剩余的推出-学习者不匹配也会沿着状态达到的策略历史累积，因此尽管历史不匹配，当前的操作可能看起来是局部对齐的。我们引入 InterQ-RL（交互感知量化强化学习）来纠正这种对齐后的不匹配。它在影响国家的政策历史上应用有界执行前缀校正，通过固定位移预算下的有效支持在行动部分之间分配校正强度，并且不需要额外的模型前向传递。我们在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 上评估从 4B 到 30B 的密集和专家混合 (MoE) 主干，所有量化臂共享相同的 8 位权重、激活和 KV 缓存 (W8A8-KV8)。在四种环境主干设置中，InterQ-RL 实现了最强的量化端点结果，将 BF16 匹配到 0.7 点以内，并在两种设置中超过了它。它匹配或超过了单独对齐的学习速度，同时避免了其后期性能回归。

papers.title: Context Is Not Free: Carbon-Aware LLM Routing for Multi-Turn LLM Web Services across Geo-Distributed Data Centers
papers.summary: The sustainability of the Web has drawn growing attention, as large language model (LLM)-based web services leave a substantial carbon footprint. These services typically run in geo-distributed data centers whose grid carbon intensity varies across regions and over time, so routing each query to a cleaner region or a smaller model can reduce emissions. A conversation, however, is a stateful web session: each turn reuses the key--value (KV) cache of its history, which resides only where earlier turns were served. Serving a turn on another deployment requires recomputing this history, whose carbon cost grows with the conversation and can outweigh the saving of the move. Existing carbon-aware LLM routers treat a conversation's queries as independent and ignore this cost. We present CarbonRouter, an online framework that jointly selects the model, GPU type, and region for each query to minimize carbon emissions. CarbonRouter introduces a cache-aware carbon cost model, which charges history recomputation to every candidate deployment using cached-token counts from the serving backends, and uses a lightweight gate that keeps a session on its cached deployment when it would likely move back at the next turn and rebuild its history again. We evaluate CarbonRouter in trace-driven experiments on two real-world conversation datasets with five LLMs, three GPU types, and four regions, where it achieves the lowest carbon of all policies. CarbonRouter reduces CO$_2$ by 16.1\% on average relative to FairCarbon, a state-of-the-art carbon-aware router with the same action space, while also improving predicted answer quality and estimated latency. Moreover, the saving rises further to 23.1\% for sessions longer than 30 turns.

quality.verdict: 问题重要且方法实用，但实证说服力仍有限。
pros: 抓住多轮会话KV缓存迁移重算这一被忽视的关键碳成本

papers.title_zh: 上下文并非免费：跨地理分布式数据中心的多轮 LLM Web 服务的碳感知 LLM 路由
papers.summary_zh: 由于基于大型语言模型 (LLM) 的网络服务会留下大量的碳足迹，因此网络的可持续性引起了越来越多的关注。这些服务通常在地理分布式数据中心中运行，其网格碳强度随地区和时间的推移而变化，因此将每个查询路由到更清洁的区域或更小的模型可以减少排放。然而，对话是有状态的 Web 会话：每个轮次都重用其历史记录的键值 (KV) 缓存，该缓存仅驻留在先前轮次服务的位置。为另一次部署提供服务需要重新计算这段历史，其碳成本随着对话的增加而增加，并且可能超过移动所节省的成本。现有的碳感知 LLM 路由器将对话的查询视为独立的，并忽略此成本。我们提出了 CarbonRouter，一个在线框架，它为每个查询联合选择模型、GPU 类型和区域，以最大限度地减少碳排放。 CarbonRouter 引入了缓存感知碳成本模型，该模型使用来自服务后端的缓存令牌计数对每个候选部署进行历史重新计算，并使用轻量级门在其缓存部署上保留会话（当它可能在下一回合返回并再次重建其历史记录时）。我们在两个真实对话数据集（具有五个法学硕士、三种 GPU 类型和四个区域）的跟踪驱动实验中评估了 CarbonRouter，它在所有策略中实现了最低的碳排放。相对于 FairCarbon（具有相同操作空间的最先进的碳感知路由器），CarbonRouter 平均减少了 16.1% 的 CO$_2$，同时还提高了预测答案质量和估计延迟。此外，对于超过 30 回合的会话，节省率进一步上升至 23.1%。

papers.title: BellowsKV: One Latent for Many Layers, Expanded on Demand
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) now serve as the backbone of agents that reason over many turns, call tools, and pursue long-horizon tasks. To avoid recomputation, a model stores the attention keys and values of all past tokens in a key-value (KV) cache. Each layer maintains its own cache, so KV-cache memory can become the main bottleneck for GPU serving. Most compression methods operate within a single layer, by quantizing the cache entries, reducing the channel dimension, or evicting less important tokens. All three lose substantial accuracy at high compression ratios. Cross-layer methods share one compressed cache across adjacent layers to go beyond this limit. However, these methods also degrade sharply at high compression ratios. We find that the KV-cache representations of adjacent layers are quite different, whereas the input hidden states of adjacent layers are highly similar. We also find that, under the same memory budget, reducing the dimension of this shared latent loses far more accuracy than quantizing it. Based on these findings, we propose BellowsKV, a training-free method that maps the hidden states of n adjacent layers to one shared latent per token. At inference time, each layer reads its own keys and values from this latent through a layer-specific projection. We keep the latent at full dimension and compress it in two other ways: BellowsKV-Quant stores the latent at low precision, which is nearly lossless because the latent has no dominant outlier channels; BellowsKV-Evict makes one shared eviction decision per block, because the layers rank token importance very similarly. Across Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B and Qwen2.5-7B, BellowsKV-Quant retains about 99% of full-cache accuracy at 3.6x compression and 97-98% at 13-14x, where the strongest cross-layer method retains at most 84% at 16x. Code: https://github.com/MorrisZJ/BellowsKV

quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据仍需更全面
pros: 抓住跨层KV差异与隐藏态相似性的关键观察，方法设计有针对性

papers.title_zh: BellowsKV：一个潜在的多层，按需扩展
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 现在成为智能体的支柱，可以进行多次推理、调用工具并执行长期任务。为了避免重新计算，模型将所有过去标记的注意键和值存储在键值 (KV) 缓存中。每层都维护自己的缓存，因此 KV 缓存可能成为 GPU 服务的主要瓶颈。大多数压缩方法在单层内运行，通过量化缓存条目、减少通道维度或驱逐不太重要的令牌。在高压缩比下，这三种方法都会损失相当大的精度。跨层方法在相邻层之间共享一个压缩缓存以超越这一限制。然而，这些方法在高压缩比下也会急剧退化。我们发现相邻层的 KV 缓存表示有很大不同，而相邻层的输入隐藏状态非常相似。我们还发现，在相同的内存预算下，减少共享潜在变量的维度比量化它损失的准确性要高得多。基于这些发现，我们提出了 BellowsKV，一种无需训练的方法，它将 n 个相邻层的隐藏状态映射到每个标记的一个共享潜在变量。在推理时，每一层通过特定于层的投影从该潜在层中读取自己的键和值。我们将潜在变量保持在全维度，并以另外两种方式对其进行压缩：BellowsKV-Quant 以低精度存储潜在变量，这几乎是无损的，因为潜在变量没有占主导地位的异常值通道； BellowsKV-Evict 对每个块做出一个共享驱逐决策，因为各层对代币重要性的排名非常相似。在 Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B 和 Qwen2.5-7B 中，BellowsKV-Quant 在 3.6 倍压缩时保留约 99% 的全缓存精度，在 13-14 倍压缩时保留 97-98%，其中最强的跨层方法在 16 倍压缩时最多保留 84%。代码：https://github.com/MorrisZJ/BellowsKV

papers.title: Attention under Bounded Key-Query Similarity: Space Complexity and Transformer Anisotropy
papers.summary: A growing body of work on KV-cache compression aims to reduce the memory requirements of autoregressive generation. These methods compress the stored context while approximately preserving attention computation, enabling generation with reduced memory consumption. Almost tight theoretical results on the worst case space complexity of attention have recently been obtained, but they are achieved by instances where queries can be perfectly aligned with keys. This directly contradicts the observed anisotropy of the key/query geometry in real transformers. In particular, it has been shown empirically that key/query cosine similarities are small even for most correlated pairs, i.e., near-perfect alignment of queries with keys does not happen in practice. In this paper, we study the space complexity of attention approximation under the assumption that key/query cosine similarities belong to a small interval around zero, i.e., a query cannot align too much with any key. We give a nearly space optimal algorithm and a corresponding space lower bound. Surprisingly, the distribution of key/query cosine similarities in our lower bound exhibits the anisotropy property empirically established and studied in the literature. Additionally, we show that the simple uniform sampling algorithm is nearly optimal for a typical range of parameters, supporting its surprising effectiveness on real datasets.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，理论贡献扎实且具现实关联。
pros: 将注意力空间下界建立在更贴近真实Transformer各向异性假设上，问题设定有新意
同时给出近最优算法与下界，并解释均匀采样在实践中有效，理论与经验联系紧密
cons: 摘要未体现充分实验验证与端到端系统收益，实际部署价值仍需更多证据

papers.title_zh: 有界键查询相似性下的注意力：空间复杂度和变压器各向异性
papers.summary_zh: 越来越多的 KV 缓存压缩工作旨在减少自回归生成的内存需求。这些方法压缩存储的上下文，同时近似保留注意力计算，从而能够减少内存消耗的生成。最近获得了关于注意力的最坏情况空间复杂度的几乎严格的理论结果，但它们是通过查询可以与键完美对齐的实例来实现的。这直接与实际 Transformer 中观察到的键/查询几何形状的各向异性相矛盾。特别是，经验表明，即使对于大多数相关对，键/查询余弦相似性也很小，即，查询与键的近乎完美的对齐在实践中不会发生。在本文中，我们在假设键/查询余弦相似度属于零附近的小区间（即查询不能与任何键对齐太多）的情况下研究注意力近似的空间复杂度。我们给出了近空间最优算法和相应的空间下界。令人惊讶的是，我们下界中的键/查询余弦相似度的分布表现出文献中根据经验建立和研究的各向异性特性。此外，我们还表明，简单的均匀采样算法对于典型的参数范围几乎是最佳的，这支持了其在真实数据集上令人惊讶的有效性。

papers.title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Long-Session Degradation in Full-Duplex Speech Models
papers.summary: End-to-end full-duplex spoken dialogue models enable natural, real-time spoken interactions with interruptions, backchannels, and overlapping speech. Prior evaluations have assessed diverse interaction capabilities and identified some degradation patterns across conversational turns. However, how model behavior evolves over extended sessions remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we address this gap by systematically characterizing long-session degradation and developing efficient methods to mitigate it. We introduce a closed-loop evaluation framework for long-session stability and apply it to several publicly available full-duplex speech models, revealing degradation over time in responsiveness, spoken content quality, and voice consistency. To mitigate this degradation, we propose a self-distillation-based training framework for lightweight LoRA adaptation that improves long-session stability with a small amount of additional training. We further introduce a two-resolution context (TRC) architecture that preserves recent interactions in full detail while compressing older interaction history into key-value representations. We evaluate our methods on three models with distinct architectures, assessing long-session stability, information retention, and computational efficiency. Across all three models, we show that LoRA adaptation mitigates performance degradation over ten-minute sessions, while adding TRC extends these gains beyond the training session length and reduces KV-cache growth by more than 90%.
papers.comment: The project page is available at https://kimjunho333.github.io/dmlsd-fdsm/

papers.title_zh: 诊断和缓解全双工语音模型中的长会话退化
papers.summary_zh: 端到端全双工语音对话模型可实现自然、实时的语音交互，包括中断、反向通道和重叠语音。之前的评估已经评估了不同的交互能力，并确定了对话轮次中的一些退化模式。然而，模型行为如何在长时间的会话中演变仍然没有得到充分的了解。在这项工作中，我们通过系统地描述长期会话退化并开发有效的方法来缓解这一差距，从而解决了这一差距。我们引入了一个用于长时间会话稳定性的闭环评估框架，并将其应用于几个公开可用的全双工语音模型，揭示了响应能力、语音内容质量和语音一致性随时间的退化。为了减轻这种退化，我们提出了一种基于自蒸馏的轻量级 LoRA 适应训练框架，通过少量的额外训练提高了长会话稳定性。我们进一步引入了一种双分辨率上下文（TRC）架构，该架构可以完整保留最近的交互细节，同时将较旧的交互历史压缩为键值表示。我们在具有不同架构的三个模型上评估我们的方法，评估长会话稳定性、信息保留和计算效率。在所有三个模型中，我们表明 LoRA 适应可以减轻十分钟会话中的性能下降，而添加 TRC 将这些收益扩展到训练会话长度之外，并将 KV 缓存增长减少 90% 以上。
